test_title: PYST 4: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 24 March 2021 (Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Four different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the face showing '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8465841ab161f3b68f302b56c94b026947ce08117626dcd2e7f893bab7f08543.png]
solution:
Taking Dice position (3) and (4), as 1 is common;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61f9f04b21d7095c64facfbb3b4d40c4640ea37f4350af9ba0339039a787cbbf.png] 

Moving clockwise from the Common number 1,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35e33fed5b5cb02ac50f95eb0d2095734a291b018bac589f8f91d43201aaecfa.png] 

Pair of opposite numbers:

1 - 5

2 - 6

3 - 4

So, the opposite number to 2 is 6.

Hence, the correct answer is "6".
